## Install

Add `rules_dx` to `MODULE.bazel`:

```python
bazel_dep(name = "rules_dx", version = "<version>")
```

Load the rules from `@rules_dx//sql:defs.bzl`:

```python
load("@rules_dx//sql:defs.bzl", "sql_library")
```

## Rules

### `sql_library`

Owns the SQL files of one package for dx quality.

| Attribute | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `srcs` | `label_list` | no | SQL files of this package. |
| `dialect` | `string` | no | SQL dialect of every source; empty lets each file's dialect suffix decide. |
| `deps` | `label_list` | no | SQL libraries this package depends on. |
